# Fidelity Money Market Funds — After-Tax Yield

## Purpose

This page compares Fidelity money market funds using scraped 7-day yields and an approximate after-tax calculation for a single filer with a selectable resident state.

## Interactions

- Choose System, Light, or Dark theme.
- Select a resident state from the supported state tax profiles.
- Select a federal marginal tax bracket.
- Select the chosen state's marginal tax bracket.
- Filter funds by category.
- Expand the fund list to show all funds.
- Use the bracket matrix to compare the winning fund for every federal and selected-state bracket combination.

## Data and assumptions

- Active tax year: 2026.
- Fund data is sourced from Fidelity's all-class money market rate sheet.
- Yields are seven-day yields and are net of the displayed expense ratio.
- State exemption percentages are approximate assumptions and may vary by year.
- Washington's separate capital-gains tax is not applied to money-market yield income.

## Accessibility

All controls are labeled and keyboard accessible. The fund list and bracket matrix expose their values in the accessibility tree.
